report_name: Critical RCE Flaw in SAUTER Building Controllers Threatens Physical Systems

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-78319
vulnerabilities.description: A critical Time-of-Check to Time-of-Use (TOCTOU) race condition (CWE-367) in the firmware update mechanism of SAUTER building automation controllers. An unauthenticated remote attacker could exploit this to achieve remote code execution by replacing a legitimate firmware file with a malicious one during the update process.
